literal: Work doers, one's own relatives, enemies, saying that thus, everyone, that which investigates is a spy.
translation: A true spy is one who investigates absolutely everyone—the officials who do the work, one's own relatives, and one's enemies.
modern: அரசுப் பணியாளர்கள், தம்முடைய உறவினர்கள், பகைவர்கள் என்று வேறுபாடு இல்லாமல் அனைவரையும் பற்றி ஆராய்ந்து அறிபவனே சிறந்த ஒற்றன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the comprehensive scope of a spy's duty. A ruler must not rely on blind trust when governing a state. Therefore, a spy ('ஒற்று') must secretly observe three specific groups: the officials executing tasks ('வினை செய்வார்'), the ruler's own inner circle of relatives ('தம் சுற்றம்'), and the adversaries ('வேண்டாதார்'). By scrutinizing absolutely everyone ('அனைவரையும்'), the spy ensures the ruler has an accurate and unbiased understanding of the state's affairs.
